title: import-map-scan
intention: Install the IMPORT_MAP scan into orient's registry — the capability-measured import list of a file: AST imports with the loose package form RESOLVED to the module that actually enters ('from cairn.machines.chart import constrain' measures as cairn.machines.chart.constrain, deterministically, via the filesystem). The six proofs carrying hand-rolled import walkers (chart-tree, chart-orient, chart-moreabout, chart-constrain, orient-nexus, inspector-nexus) recompose over it — six parallel scans retire; allowlists keep their full physics but match on WHICH MODULE ENTERED, never on how the import was spelled.
why: The same red fired twice in one day: allowlist teeth recorded ast.ImportFrom.module verbatim, so the loose form recorded as its prefix and was refused although the module entering is exactly the one the precise spelling admits. The teeth measured the SPELLING, not the capability — orient's founding lesson, recommitted inside the proofs themselves. The fix applied twice was a respelling: treating the symptom. Measured before deciding (Law 3): 70 loose-form cairn-internal imports repo-wide — the form is the house idiom, which REFUTED the reflex answer (a build_inspector filter banning the form would red 70 healthy sites and trip the always-fires falsifier). So the measurement resolves the form instead of banning it. THE STORY THIS TICKET EXISTS TO KEEP: this is the FIRST CORRECTION TO RIDE ORIENT'S OWN BRICK LOOP END TO END — deposited into the corrections corpus (node cd9e57c05b35661b, dated, naming both reds), walked (the corpus placed it at 0.6704/0.6532 beside the echo-label and emit-homonym scars — recognizing the word-not-capability FAMILY, third member, before any human said so), proposed through propose_scan (the admission gate traveling in the artifact), ratified by Akien, installed with the dated provenance tooth 12 demands. The machinery built this morning carried its first real learning by evening.
traces_to: Law 1 — a settled failure class compiles into structure that fires itself; six parallel import walkers become one settled scan
Law 3 — the territory was measured before the fix was chosen, and the measurement overturned the reflex answer (filter -> scan)
Law 4 — the admission was physics end to end: dated-correction provenance (tooth 12), the proposal artifact carrying its own gate, ratification, installation
orient's founding why — a proxy was read instead of the thing: the spelling instead of the module; this scan ends that class inside the proofs that guard everything else

falsifier.proves_green: proof gate: test_orient tooth 16 (three spellings measure identically; unresolvable names record their stated prefix; missing/unparseable files refuse) + tooth 12 (registry membership + dated provenance) under the tester's netns seal; the six recomposed proofs re-sealed. Live gate: the next loose-form import in an allowlisted file draws NO spurious red — and a genuinely off-list module still refuses.
falsifier.proves_red: RED on any of: the three spellings of one module measuring differently; a genuinely off-list module passing a recomposed allowlist (the physics must survive the recomposition); an unparseable or missing file reported as an empty import list; a proof regrowing a hand-rolled import walker beside the settled scan (the parallel-scan drift, again); the scan consulting anything but AST + filesystem (a measurement stays deterministic and replayable).
falsifier.horizon: re-read when a third spelling form appears (conditional imports, importlib) — the scan grows against the measured need; when the inspector wants an import-shaped filter (it composes THIS scan, never a parallel walk); when the next correction rides the loop (this ticket is the precedent for how).
